title: Tourism Explorer Resource
description: Provides structured discovery of tourist attractions, landmarks, museums, temples, monuments, parks, and sights based on location and category.

supportedIntents.description: Queries seeking attractions, things to do, landmarks, museums, sights, temples, or points of interest near a specific destination.
example: Best places to visit in Kurukshetra

schema.description: Tourism query object extracted from user search.

type.description: Kind of request: 'list' for multiple attractions or 'query' for filtered discovery.

filters.description: Filters including category, destination, and radius.

destination.description: Destination city, region, or landmark name.
